content:
The workbook generation failed due to invalid Excel formulas resulting in #NAME? errors in the statistics section.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with an AssertionError in test_outputs.py. Specifically, cells H46 through L47 returned #NAME? instead of the expected numerical statistics (e.g., H46 expected -1.591577, got #NAME?). This indicates that the formulas used for the 'statistics' matrix are either referencing undefined names, using unsupported functions, or contain syntax errors that openpyxl/Excel cannot resolve.
